prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1383; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Records show long-standing treatment for the same condition before the crash; most of the current complaints come from it.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a rear-end motor vehicle collision with wrist pain and swelling. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with a crash of this type. Radiographs and physical examination clearly confirm a fracture of the distal radius. Over five visits, the patient was managed with immobilization, pain control, and follow-up imaging. Recovery has been somewhat slower than is usual for this injury, so the course of care ran longer than typical.

Review of the records shows the patient was under long-standing treatment for the same wrist region before this collision. Much of the current complaint of discomfort appears to stem from that earlier condition rather than from the recent fracture alone. Billing records for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services.
